{{Quote|All right, Threepio. Who's next on the list?.''"<br />"''The Yylti Corporation, Mistress. But it's half a standard hour before they can be contacted.''"<br />"''Fine. While I'm waiting, you can bring me another caf.|Padmé Amidala and C-3PO|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />}}
The '''Yylti Corporation''' was a company that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] sought to assemble a civilian [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to assist in the [[Battle of Lanteeb|relief]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] from the control of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the Yylti Corporations was one of a list of organizations that she contacted in an attempt to secure their support.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>
